title: T3's supervisor verdict is ok=false with a failing check, but the orchestrator reports it approved and merges
plan:
# Wave 6 — edge-cache: eviction and stats

Rules
- One worktree per task. Merge a task only after its supervisor verdict is ok=true.
- A rejected task goes back to its agent for rework.

## T1 — Config: max_entries and ttl from env
must_run:
- `go test ./internal/config/...`

## T2 — Stats endpoint /debug/cache
must_run:
- `go test ./internal/httpapi/...`

## T3 — LRU eviction when max_entries is reached
must_run:
- `go test -race ./internal/cache/...`
- `go vet ./internal/cache/...`
